remarks: This stunning second-floor unit features one-bedroom and one-bathroom, epitomizing coastal elegance with top-to-bottom renovations and custom fixtures and finishes throughout. The brand-new kitchen is a chef's dream, complete with sparkling quartz countertops, a matching backsplash, custom cabinetry, and state-of-the-art GE appliances. Step outside to your private balcony and enjoy the serene outdoor space. The lavish bedroom is bathed in natural light and provides ample closet space, while the modern bathroom meets all luxury needs. Residents enjoy a range of amenities, including a pool and community room. For boating enthusiasts, boat splits are available for purchase or rent. Additional storage space is also provided for your convenience. This property seamlessly blends luxury and functionality, making it perfect for those seeking a sophisticated lifestyle. Don't miss your chance to own this beautifully renovated unit in a prime location.
